exchangeUnit: Infinity or an Infinity-derived service coin
requirements: Every purchase, bid, unlock, payout, and service request posts to an Infinity ledger.
A derived product coin must record its Infinity source and service purpose.
Repository scans must include generated dependency metadata and user-visible copy.
A failed scan creates a bounded repair job and a regression check.
No robot may claim a browser-local prototype is a shared authenticated ledger.
